_meta.description: Restaurants featured on Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives (and similar food TV) within ~75 miles of the Grand Junction → Hutchinson → Kansas City → Pittsburgh → Titusville corridor.

entries.name: Bin 707 Foodbar
entries.blurb: Featured for elevated farm-to-table on Triple D Western Colorado tour.

entries.name: Suehiro Japanese Restaurant
entries.blurb: DDD-featured sushi and tempura on the High Plains.

entries.name: Cozy Inn
entries.blurb: Tiny 1922 slider stand featured on Triple D — six stools, onions everywhere.

entries.name: Grandy's Donuts
entries.blurb: Old-school cake donuts; classic Plains diner stop.

entries.name: Arthur Bryant's Barbeque
entries.blurb: Legendary KC BBQ, featured on countless food shows.

entries.name: Z's Divine Eatery
entries.blurb: DDD-featured comfort food in the city.

entries.name: Niecie's Restaurant
entries.blurb: DDD soul food spot in KC.

entries.name: Hamburg Inn No. 2
entries.blurb: Featured on DDD; coin caucus and pie shakes.

entries.name: Superdawg Drive-In
entries.blurb: Vintage Chicago drive-in with mascot dogs on the roof.

entries.name: Pamela's P&G Diner (Strip District)
entries.blurb: DDD-featured crepe hotcakes; Obama's favorite Pittsburgh diner.

entries.name: Primanti Bros. (Original)
entries.blurb: Strip District original — sandwiches with fries inside.

entries.name: Blue Canoe
entries.blurb: Local Titusville favorite; comfort food, friendly to road-tripped families.
